recipe.title: Grandma's Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Combine flour and baking soda in a small bowl.
Beat butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar, and vanilla extract in a large bowl until creamy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Gradually beat in flour mixture, then stir in chocolate chips.
Drop by rounded tablespoons onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes or until golden brown.
